    # Create adjacency lists for both parts of the bipartite graph
    adj_list_u = defaultdict(list)
    adj_list_v = defaultdict(list)

    for i, (u, v) in enumerate(edges):

        adj_list_u[u].append(v)
        adj_list_v[v].append(u)

    # Find the minimal k-covering for each k from min_degree to 1
